title: ContextEnvelope
description: A point-in-time report of an Agent Run's context window state plus the context actually attached to it (binder ch03 agent.heartbeat context, ch04 compaction). Powers context-pressure planning: the planner prepares a split or successor before the body is out of room, never after.

pressure.description: Planner-facing summary derived from used/window ratio and growth rate.

contextRefs.description: What was actually loaded: files read, rules consulted, memory episodes retrieved, skill grafts attached, predecessor packets.

droppable.description: Priority signal for context budgeting under pressure.

compactionPacketRef.description: Latest compaction/checkpoint packet event id, if one exists.

sourceEventId.description: The heartbeat or context_pressure transcript event this envelope was derived from.
